meta.name: buzz-devrel
meta.description: Developer relations playbook builder — produces a DevRel program design covering community platform, contributor program tiers, ambassador criteria, event strategy, and success metrics. Use when asked to "build a DevRel program", "design our developer community", "create a contributor program", "start a developer advocacy program", or "how do we grow our dev community".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并生成开发者关系完整计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责开发者关系或社区运营
copy.tagline_en: Design and generate a complete developer relations plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage developer relations or community operations

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会变成一个开发者关系方案构建器。它会逐步收集背景信息，然后输出包含社区平台、贡献者层级、大使标准、活动策略、成功指标和 90 天启动清单的完整方案。
howto.when: 当你要求“构建 DevRel 方案”、“设计开发者社区”或“创建贡献者计划”等类似任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个开发者关系方案。
say.note: Claude 会开始收集信息并生成方案。

say.text: 为我们的开源项目制定贡献者层级。
say.note: Claude 会输出贡献者阶梯定义。
Claude 会提供大使选拔标准和职责。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude acts as a Developer Relations Playbook Builder. It gathers context and outputs a comprehensive plan covering community platform, contributor tiers, ambassador criteria, event strategy, success metrics, and a 90-day launch checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to 'build a DevRel program', 'design our developer community', 'create a contributor program', or similar requests.

say_en.text: Help me design a developer relations program.
say_en.note: Claude will start gathering info and generate the plan.

say_en.text: Create contributor tiers for our open source project.
say_en.note: Claude will output contributor ladder definitions.

say_en.text: How do we set up an ambassador program?
say_en.note: Claude will provide ambassador criteria and responsibilities.
